_about: #1015 (R212) retired name Overhand. 'keep' lists every kept use with its reason; 'gate' is the only place tools/brand_gate/retired.py takes exceptions from (each shown: false).

keep.reason: Changing it makes a new app: no install over the old one, settings and receipts lost, new store record.

keep.what: module path native/overhand and source paths
keep.reason: Build and scripts depend on it; never shown.
Code identifiers; never shown. The launcher shows the label.

keep.what: log tags Overhand* and thread/sound/preference ids (overhand-mic, overhand-earcon, overhand-audio, overhand_origin)
keep.reason: The worn-check and session scripts read the tags (tools/session_capture/score_session.py); never shown.

keep.what: [Overhand test N] fixture marker (FirstMinutes.kt:9, DecisionCards.kt:650, assets/windows.js:74)
keep.reason: Matched to hide host test fixtures; never drawn (RetiredNameTest; the rendered scope of the gate has no exception).

keep.what: signing certificate CN=Overhand Release and keystore file overhand-release.jks
keep.reason: Changing the key breaks install-over; the certificate name is not shown in the headset.

keep.what: recorded day and judge maps (assets/judge/*), as stored
keep.reason: Hash-locked recording (receipt hash); shown only through RecordedText.neutral, which says Flowstate.

keep.what: Web C8 build (web/**), its storage keys overhand.*.v1 and console tags
keep.reason: Frozen C8 (#1006); the Head decides on a rename-only Web build.

keep.what: history: take_0x verification files, runs/, logs, .autoflow/wiki, old reports and old drafts not in scripts/judge_facing_files.txt
developer dashboard app record name and the competition submission URL slug
keep.reason: External records: only developer can rename them; docs say so where they navigate there.

gate.reason: The recorded day and its maps are hash-locked recordings (receipt hash). Every reader shows them through RecordedText.neutral, which says Flowstate (RetiredNameTest, and the rendered scope of this gate).
Same recordings inside the APK; shown only through RecordedText.neutral (see the src entry).
The [Overhand test N] fixture marker regex: matched to hide test fixtures, never drawn (FirstMinutes.kt:9, DecisionCards.kt:650).
Same fixture marker regex inside the APK.
Silent voice alias: a key phrase the matcher hears; keys are never shown or spoken.
Same silent voice alias inside the APK.
Module path native/overhand, package com.overhand.app, the signing key file and class names are kept (R212 renames only what is shown); a path in an evidence note is not the product's name.
Browser storage keys of the frozen C8 Web build (identifiers in web/, which this card may not change); the privacy table must name the real key.
The submission URL slug the competition site assigned; a link, not the product's name. It changes only if the site renames the entry.
